name: Hero-God's Rage
disable: DC 18 Athletics check (trained) to subdue the spirit, DC 18 Religion check to calm the spirit, DC 16 Deception check or DC 16 Diplomacy check to talk the spirit down; two total successes are required to disable the haunt
routine: (1 action) Sophreista lashes out at the nearest living creature, dealing 1d10+6 bludgeoning damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save save) and binding their fate to hers; a creature that critically fails their save is Doomed 1 (maximum Doomed 3).

items.name: Cry Havoc
items.text:
Trigger The performance concludes with fewer than 8 Pathos Points

---
Effect Sophreista screams in rage; all living creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 20 Will save save or be Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

text: Sophreista's ghost glows red, and shrieking in fury, she flies at her opponents.
